note: Figure pass over an ALREADY-STAGED chapter, run as a rehearsal before Chapter 7. Cards were not regenerated; from_idx was backfilled and figures attached. Full write-up in REPORT.md.

new_hazards_found.what: caption detection required a © credit line, so photo-credited figures ("Courtesy of…") were silently missed
length-capping the credit line dropped real figures, because the extractor welds the credit onto the next paragraph
save_art returned a cached file before checking that art was found, so a caption adopted a stale image
the attach undo record was not segment-scoped; ch4 overwrote ch6
new_hazards_found.why: filesystem naming, not card content: no card artifact to assert against. Guarded by the per-segment filename and a reconstruct-from-deck recipe in REPORT.md.

new_hazards_found.what: the undo record replaced instead of accumulating, shrinking 99 entries to 7 on a re-run
new_hazards_found.why: same: a property of the run record, not of any card. Fixed by merging on (noteId, media).

new_hazards_found.what: re-running after a matcher change added a SECOND figure rather than swapping
a TABLE/FIGURE caption's context was never widened forward, so the next page was fetched and then discarded by a 450-char cut; 6 correct ch4 cards were HARD-blocked as ungrounded
attach_figures wrote the figure to Anki but not to the canon cards file, so the gate could block a card for lacking evidence that was already on it
